stack.title: Engineering Stack
stack.subtitle: Backend engineering, AI automation, and the cloud/architecture practices that keep it all running in production.

about.title: Driven by Engineering Excellence
about.p1: I'm a backend engineer now focused on AI-driven automation — currently building agentic workflows and automation pipelines in Python and NestJS. My background is in the Java/Spring ecosystem, which shaped how I think about clean architecture and maintainable systems.
about.p2: I'm a Systems Analyst, currently in my 4th year of engineering and on track to also earn degrees in Artificial Intelligence and Systems Engineering. That gave me a solid foundation in software architecture, databases, and development best practices — knowledge I apply to every project, prioritizing clean code and well-structured solutions.
about.p3: I have hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud services on AWS and Azure. I understand that good code is just one part: deployment, monitoring, and maintenance are equally important.
